description: Browse Amazon products by category. Omit category to list all available categories. Provide a category name to get products in that category.

category.description: Category name to browse. Omit to list all available categories.

limit.description: Number of products to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

region.description: Country code (e.g. uk, us, de). Defaults to uk.

name: browse_by_category
